label: Over-rim critical arcs
description: Area (open-bowl) perimeter arcs that hide a rim climb yet are the only lift-escape for a node — deleting them strands the orange node.

label: Elevation reversal candidates
description: Piste edges that flip direction once mis-sampled elevations are corrected against the Terrarium DEM. Green = suggested top, orange = current (too-high) top; red line = strong, orange line = marginal.

label: Plateau traverses (app-added)
description: Bidirectional flat traverses the plateau pass added to reconnect points that sit on the same shelf (<=45 m apart, <=8 m height) but were severed because every mapped link out was one-way downhill. Numbered most-questionable first; pink = marginal.

label: Uphill piste edges (bug)
description: Piste edges that point uphill because a T-junction split was never re-oriented. The router can use them as a free lift. Red = climbs, blue = the correctly-descending other half, orange = the app-added split node.
